title: Olive and Fig in the Barn
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, consonants x, y, z added, 29-sound stage.

pages.brief: Olive the grey owl and Fig the green caterpillar standing together at the open doorway of an old wooden barn.
A wide dim view inside the barn, tall stacks of hay, little light coming through the gaps.
Olive the owl hopping onto an old wooden box in the dim barn, peering inside it.
Olive the owl perched on the hay bale with her beak open, calling out into the dim barn.
An empty hay bale top and an empty plain clay pot on the barn floor, Olive peering down from above at both.
Fig the green caterpillar poking his head out of the top of a cloth sack on the barn floor, grinning.
Olive the owl hopping down beside the sack, smiling at Fig.
Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar sitting side by side on the hay bale together.
